_meta.note: Cute set for region 6 (Tidewater). DESIGN ONLY, not built. 2 rare + 4 uncommon. All single-stage.
_meta.dex_no: unassigned until Gary/World Design slot them

creatures.name: Puffgill
creatures.visual_brief: Round baby sea-robin fish with fan-like pectoral 'wings' it flaps on sand; big glossy eyes, pink belly. Palette: coral pink, sand, teal, violet. Crystal: small violet crystal on its brow.
creatures.flavour: Hops along the tideline on its fins and sulks when a wave knocks it over.

creatures.name: Kelpkit
creatures.visual_brief: Sea-otter kit wrapped in a kelp blanket like a scarf, holding a tiny shell; floats belly-up. Palette: cocoa brown, kelp green, cream, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on the shell it holds.
creatures.flavour: Ties itself to kelp so it does not drift away while it naps.

creatures.name: Drizzlop
creatures.visual_brief: Chubby storm-petrel chick, grey down puffed like a raincloud, little webbed feet; a drip hangs off its beak. Palette: storm grey, white, slate blue, violet. Crystal: violet crystal tuft on its head.
creatures.flavour: Only sings when it rains, then sings all night.

creatures.name: Cocklet
creatures.visual_brief: Tiny hermit-snail creature living in a ribbed cockle shell, two stalk eyes and a soft peach body. Palette: peach, cream shell, rose, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on the shell's hinge.
creatures.flavour: Swaps shells with friends as a sign of trust.

creatures.name: Foamfawn
creatures.visual_brief: Small sea-spray fawn with a seafoam mane and frothy tail, hooves leave bubbles. Palette: aqua, white foam, pale gold, violet. Crystal: violet crystal on its forehead.
creatures.flavour: Seen only where waves hit the rocks hardest, playing in the spray.

creatures.name: Nubbinray
creatures.visual_brief: Pocket-sized round ray, smiling underside, freckled back, stubby tail with a bow-like fin. Palette: dusty blue, pale cream, navy freckles, violet. Crystal: violet crystal at tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Glides in rock pools and lets children stroke its back.
